failure: Initial /hardware/reset_safety returned success=false before planning; acceptance.py line 102
root_cause: The joint state broadcaster published its initialized URDF pose before the hardware transport accepted the first MuJoCo feedback packet. Observer freshness and active controllers do not prove hardware-subscriber feedback readiness. The reset service correctly refused the premature reset, but the acceptance client treated this expected startup condition as a final failure.
fix: Physical hardware starts in latched hold with feedback invalidated. Initial acceptance reset uses the authoritative real hardware service with a 10-second deadline, recording each rejection. Physical stale reset refusal, explicit reset recovery, bounds, freshness, collision and trajectory assertions are unchanged.
regression: Actual C++ DDS verifies initialized pose alone cannot reset, stale feedback cannot reset, an accepted fresh packet can reset, and timeout rejects reset again. Complete real ROS mock and MuJoCo acceptance passed; MuJoCo startup reproduced five Fresh state required refusals before the sixth request succeeded.
